entry.title: what i learned about dark mode
entry.content:
Short post: dark mode is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Dark mode shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
